projects.verificationMethod: Refresh audit input manifest and validate surface / semantic / nativeization plan.
Run managed proof and validate managed semantics baseline.
Run native / AOT proof and validate generated native code execution.
Run patch / host proof and validate hotupdate consumer path.
Run benchmarks and archive performance results.
Review generated code, dispatch, helpers, bindings, and coverage artifacts.
Aggregate project results and produce DLL completion conclusion.
